_about: Alfred Marshall (1842-1924), Cambridge economist: Principles of Economics, an introductory volume, eighth edition (London: Macmillan, 1920), the definitive text, raw IA OCR, clean 0.94. Not taken: the earlier editions (1890 onward) on IA, which the eighth revises. US public domain. Not Beatrice Marshall or Marshall Saunders.
